The PCI ID for this device is found in the driver set for the [[ASUS PCE-AC68]]. :It seems to be using the default BCM4352 ID. 
BCM4352_D11AC_ID	0x43b1    /* 4352 802.11ac dualband */
BCM4352_D11AC2G_ID	0x43b2    /* 4352 802.11ac 2.4G device */
BCM4352_D11AC5G_ID	0x43b3    /* 4352 802.11ac 5G device */
===Review of Linux Compatibility=== *[http://linux-hardware-guide.com/2014-11-02-asus-pce-ac56-pcie-802-11ac-1300mbits-2x2-mimo-turboqam '''Asus PCE-AC56'''] (PCIe, 802.11ac, 1300Mbps, 2×2 MIMO, TurboQAM) :The Asus PCE-AC56 is a PCI Express WiFi card with PCI ID: 14e4:43b1 
03:00.0 Network controller [0280]: Broadcom Corporation Device [14e4:43b1] (rev 03)
 The card uses the [[Broadcom]] BCM4352 chipset and wireless connections of 802.11ac standard. :Until now there is no Linux driver for the Asus PCE-AC56 in the Linux standard kernel. :However, a driver for the used chipset is [http://www.broadcom.com/support/802.11/linux_sta.php provided by Broadcom for download]. :This driver has to be compiled and installed per hand.
